stemMd: Independent events have probabilities 0.3 and 0.6. What is the probability that exactly one occurs?
explanationMd: Exactly one consists of two disjoint cases: $0.3(0.4)+0.7(0.6)=0.12+0.42=0.54$. Both-occurring outcomes must be excluded twice from the sum of individual probabilities.

distractorRationale.d: Adds event probabilities without correcting overlap.
